Junior Marketing Manager

Location:
Vienna, Austria
Employment type:
Full-time
Department:
Marketing

Your role

You plan and run our product campaigns across the DACH region, from the first idea to the performance report. You work closely with the sales team, our designers and two agency partners, and you own the content calendar for our customer newsletter and social channels.

What you bring

  • First experience in B2B marketing, an internship counts
  • Confident German and English writing
  • Hands-on experience with at least one campaign or CMS tool
  • Curiosity about analytics dashboards and A/B testing

What we offer

  • Public transport ticket and lunch allowance
  • Two remote days per week
  • A yearly training budget you actually get to spend
